hints.text: A decimal like this one can be broken into a whole part and a tenths part. Multiply each part by five.
Split $1.2$ into $1 + 0.2$. Work out $1 \times 5$ and $0.2 \times 5$ separately, and then add the two results.
The parts are $1 \times 5 = 5$ and $0.2 \times 5 = 1$, so the product is $5 + 1 = 6$.

explanation: Split the decimal so each part is easy to multiply: $1.2 \times 5 = (1 + 0.2) \times 5$.
Multiply each part: $1 \times 5 = 5$, and $0.2 \times 5 = 1.0$ because five groups of two tenths make ten tenths.
Add the two parts: $5 + 1 = 6$, so the product $1.2 \times 5$ is $6$.
